message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, but I can give you a quick overview of what Boston’s weather usually looks like:

| Season | Typical Temperature (°F) | Common Weather |
|--------|--------------------------|----------------|
| Winter | 20–30 °F (–6 to –1 °C)   | Snow, sleet, cold winds |
| Spring | 45–60 °F (7–16 °C)      | Rain showers, occasional thunderstorms |
| Summer | 70–85 °F (21–29 °C)     | Warm, humid, occasional heat waves |
| Fall   | 50–65 °F (10–18 °C)     | Cool, crisp, colorful foliage |

If you’re planning a trip or need a current forecast, you might want to check a reliable weather site or app (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service). Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of Boston’s climate or anything else!
